network_identity.finality_basis: 19 distinct active SRs signing a consecutive native block branch at or above the target; RPC SolidityNode status alone is insufficient

adapter.outbound_recipient: 21-byte TRON hex address: 0x41 prefix plus 20-byte account payload

activation_requirements: production ITronFinalityVerifier420 implementation proves transaction inclusion in a solidified TRON mainnet block
production verifier validates the final execution result from the solidified receipt where execution status applies
canonical bridge gateway account is governance allowlisted
TRX asset id and route id are governance bound
route risk caps and emergency isolation are configured
end-to-end inbound and outbound qualification passes
security_invariants: transaction replay under a different message id fails closed
direct adapter calls bypassing GatewayRouter420 fail closed
outbound recipients must be exactly 21 bytes and begin with 0x41

verifier.trust_model: Governance-authenticated canonical checkpoint and ordered 27-SR witness-permission snapshot, bounded before maintenance or permission/consensus changes; native signature/ancestry/solidification verification, not autonomous election replay
verifier.profile_installation: Explicit installProfile; unknown/disabled profiles fail closed; no production profile automatically installed
verifier.execution: Native TransferContract only; full transaction protobuf Merkle leaf commits signatures and any execution result; failed results and TVM/TRC token paths reject
verifier.proof_abi: DepositProof(bytes32 profile,uint64 number,bytes transaction,uint32 index,uint32 count,bytes32[] siblings)
